hypothesis: Measured concurrency-specific costs and full-depth probe cadence could improve accepted output per total serving step.
decision: Retain original adaptive policy. Repeated fixed-depth testing found no useful general winner. All fitted screens are within0.3% overall of original and all reduce the C4 geometric mean by2.6–2.9%; none earns further production qualification in this bounded pass.
quality: Three fitted policies passed eight functional checks each. No changed policy is promoted; original numerical qualification remains applicable. Native/Pi/Code/Chat acceptance passed after explicit original selection on the same image and containers.
limitations: Each fitted candidate has one18-cell screen visit bracketed by two original visits. This rejects promotion for insufficient demonstrated benefit; it does not establish statistical equivalence or universal regression.
No full numerical qualification was run for the fitted policies because none qualified for promotion on this performance screen.
Output rates include cached prefill and delivery with256output tokens and cannot be compared directly with the512-token historical serving baseline.
Cost fits use homogeneous code/prose prompts; heterogeneous expert routing and adaptive exploration can change realized costs.
